params.name: id
params.description: Unique id that identities the resource

params.name: parts
params.description: Specify which parts of the profile to return, can be one or more separated by comma ( , ). If not specified (empty), all assets will be returned

params.name: has_lists_description
params.description: If true, returns a description for the three lists types (Sanctions List, Other Exclusion List and Other Official Lists), if false, then no description is returned.

params.name: is_audit
params.description: (Available from version 2.3+) Boolean flag to control if a request should be auditted of not.

params.name: profile_notes_target_language
params.description: Specifies the language to translate to using iso-639-1 language code.

items.docs: Get R&C profile given an profile id. It is possible to get only parts of the profile, to reduce response size, using the parts parameter.

info.name: Get Profile Notes by Profile id

params.name: id
params.description: Unique id that identities the resource

params.name: parts
params.description: Specify which parts of the profile notes to return, can be one or more separated by comma ( , ). If not specified (empty), all assets will be returned

params.name: target_language
params.description: Specifies the language to translate to using iso-639-1 language code.

items.docs: Get profile notes from a profile given its id.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique id that identities the resource

items.docs: Get an image given an image reference id.  Can only retrieve one image at a time

info.name: Get the connection details for a profile

params.name: id
params.description: Unique id that identities the resource

params.name: filter[type]
params.description: Filter by profile type (available up to version 2.6)

params.name: filter[type_code]
params.description: Filter by profile type code (available from version 2.7)

params.name: filter[connection_type]
params.description: Filter by connection type (available up to version 2.6)

params.name: filter[connection_type_code]
params.description: Filter by connection type code (available from version 2.7)

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: number of items in each page

items.docs: Get a list of connectionDetails for a given profile ID. It is possible to filter through name, type, connection and icon. It is also possible to get the results ordered and with pagination.
